backend/main.mo: Motoko actor defining the backend canister with types and logic for storing a control panel layout, logging GPIO events (capped at 100), and querying events by control ID.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping two features—fixing GPIO HTTP POST fetch calls in gpioHttp.ts and fixing the DebugHttpPanel manual send button—to their relevant source files and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document containing one-sentence summaries of each frontend source file, serving as a reference index for the project's React/TypeScript frontend components, hooks, and utilities.
frontend/docs/linux-local-test-bundle.md: Guide explaining how to download, extract, and run the self-contained Linux test bundle for the GPIO Control Panel, including its contents and quick-start steps.
frontend/docs/rpi-bash-runner.md: Documentation for the Raspberry Pi GPIO event runner script that polls the backend canister for events and executes corresponding GPIO commands on local hardware.
frontend/docs/rpi-bash-runner.md.backup: Empty backup file of the rpi-bash-runner documentation with no content.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS stylesheet defining dark-theme OKLCH CSS custom properties, control panel utility classes, fullscreen workspace styles, and custom scrollbar styling.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML entry point for the Vite/React app, mounting the root div and loading the main TypeScript module.
Bash helper library providing a `run_step` function that executes build/deploy commands and prints detailed diagnostic output including the last 100 log lines on failure.
frontend/scripts/linux_bundle_run.sh: Bash launcher script for the Linux test bundle that starts a local ICP replica, deploys the control panel, and supports --stop, --clean, and --help flags.
frontend/scripts/package_linux_bundle.sh: Bash script that builds the frontend and backend canister, then packages the artifacts into a timestamped .tar.gz bundle for Linux/Raspberry Pi distribution. Validates dependencies, runs build steps with diagnostics, and assembles the archive in the project root.
frontend/scripts/rpi_event_runner.env.ex: Example environment variable configuration file for the Raspberry Pi GPIO event runner script, documenting required (CANISTER_ID, NETWORK) and optional (DRY_RUN, POLL_INTERVAL, STATE_FILE, ALLOWED_PREFIX) settings.
frontend/scripts/rpi_event_runner.servic: Example systemd service unit file for running the GPIO event runner as a background service on a Raspberry Pi, with restart-on-failure and journal logging configured.
frontend/scripts/rpi_event_runner.sh: Bash script that continuously polls a backend ICP canister for GPIO events and executes whitelisted gpioset commands on a Raspberry Pi, with dry-run support, state tracking to avoid duplicate execution, and configurable poll interval.
frontend/scripts/rpi_pin_test.sh: Bash script for verifying GPIO wiring on a Raspberry Pi by toggling pins 26, 6, 22, and 4 in interactive or automatic mode, with dry-run support and no canister dependency required.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that wraps the application in a dark-themed ThemeProvider, renders the ControlPanelScreen, and includes a Toaster for notifications.
frontend/src/components/control-panel/Ad: React modal dialog for creating new control panel controls, supporting types button, toggle, slider, radio, and dial with type-specific configuration fields and auto-generated decimal codes.
frontend/src/components/control-panel/Co: React context provider that manages control panel layout state, syncing with the ICP backend canister via React Query for loading and saving layouts, and exposing CRUD operations for controls.
Renders individual control widgets (button, toggle, slider, radio, dial) and handles their interaction logic including press/release events, GPIO signal sending, and emitting signals to the backend.
frontend/src/components/control-panel/Cr: A button component that opens the AddControlModal to create new controls, disabled when not in edit mode or while loading, with tooltip feedback.
frontend/src/components/control-panel/De: A debug UI card that allows manually sending HTTP POST GPIO signals with configurable button number and on/off state, displaying the result of each request.
frontend/src/components/control-panel/Dr: Wraps a control with drag-and-drop positioning logic, updating the control's x/y coordinates via mouse events when in draggable (edit) mode.
frontend/src/components/control-panel/Fu: A button that toggles fullscreen mode, showing Maximize/Minimize icons accordingly and displaying a toast error if fullscreen is unsupported or fails.
frontend/src/components/control-panel/Im: A card panel providing layout export (download as JSON) and import (paste JSON and apply) functionality, disabled in interact mode.
frontend/src/components/control-panel/In: A sidebar inspector panel that displays and allows editing of all properties for the currently selected control, including position, size, codes, and type-specific config like slider/radio/dial options.
frontend/src/components/control-panel/Mo: A toggle button that switches the panel between Edit and Interact modes using the usePanelMode hook.
frontend/src/components/control-panel/Re: Displays a scrollable list of recently emitted control signals with timestamps, control type, value, decimal code, and optional GPIO command string, with a refresh button.
frontend/src/components/control-panel/Us: Renders a placeholder card UI section labeled 'Custom Extensions' where users can add their own React components and custom functionality.
frontend/src/components/control-panel/Wo: Renders the control panel workspace canvas, displaying all draggable/selectable controls and clearing selection when switching to interact mode.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and returns an authenticated or anonymous ICP backend actor using React Query, invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useControlLayout.ts: Defines and exports the ControlLayoutContext and useControlLayout hook for accessing control panel layout state and operations.
frontend/src/hooks/useFullscreen.ts: Custom hook that manages fullscreen state for a given element ref, providing enter, exit, and toggle functions with cross-browser support.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication via an AuthClient-backed React context, exposing login, logout, and identity state with status tracking.
frontend/src/hooks/usePanelMode.ts: Module-level shared state hook that manages and persists the panel mode ('edit' or 'interact') using useSyncExternalStore and localStorage.
frontend/src/hooks/useRecentSignals.ts: Custom hook that polls the backend actor every 2 seconds to fetch and return recent signal events using React Query.
frontend/src/hooks/useSignalEmitter.ts: Custom hook that emits control signals by logging events to the ICP backend actor and optionally sending HTTP GPIO signals, with toast error handling.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS file defining Tailwind base styles, dark-theme CSS custom properties (oklch color tokens), control panel-specific styles, fullscreen layout rules, and custom scrollbar styling.
frontend/src/lib/binaryCode.ts: Empty file with no content; likely a placeholder for binary code utility functions.
frontend/src/lib/buttonCode.ts: Provides utilities for validating, generating, and converting decimal button codes (1-16), including conversion between decimal and 4-bit binary strings for GPIO use.
frontend/src/lib/controlDefaults.ts: Returns default configuration objects for each control type (button, toggle, slider, radio, dial) and generates appropriate dual decimal codes based on control type.
frontend/src/lib/download.ts: Exports a single utility function that triggers a browser download of data as a JSON file.
frontend/src/lib/gpioHttp.ts: Sends GPIO signals via HTTP POST to a local server at localhost:3000/gpio with a button number and on/off state, with error handling for network and HTTP failures.
frontend/src/lib/gpiosetCommands.ts: Generates gpioset CLI command strings from decimal codes (1-16) by mapping 4-bit binary values to GPIO pins, and logs commands for control interactions.
frontend/src/lib/layoutSerialization.ts: Validates, exports, and imports control panel layout configurations as JSON, checking control types, decimal code ranges, positions, and sizes.
frontend/src/lib/safeBrowser.ts: Provides safe wrappers for browser APIs (localStorage, location, fullscreen) that gracefully handle unavailability or blocked access without throwing errors.
frontend/src/lib/utils.ts: Exports a single `cn` utility that merges Tailwind CSS class names using clsx and tailwind-merge.
frontend/src/main.tsx: React app entry point that mounts the app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider wrappers.
Main screen component rendering the control panel UI with a header, edit/interact mode-aware sidebars (inspector, signals, debug), a central workspace, and a footer.
frontend/src/types/controlPanel.ts: Defines TypeScript types for control panel entities including ControlType, RadioOption, ControlConfig (with all decimal code and type-specific fields), and LayoutConfig.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the default theme with OKLCH-based design tokens, custom border radii, accordion animations, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animate.
project_state.json: Tracks project state for fixing failing GPIO HTTP POST fetch requests, listing two existing fix features targeting gpioHttp.ts and DebugHttpPanel. Records known issues with fetch configuration and no active new feature requests.
